[nginx-1.31.7](https://nginx.org/en/download.html) mainline version has been [released](https://blog.nginx.org/blog/nginx-1-31-7-native-geoip2-support-http-2-priorities-and-quic-improvements), with fixes for [buffer overflow](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) vulnerability when using alias with rewrite (CVE-2026-15176), [buffer overflow](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) vulnerability when evaluating string expressions with variables (CVE-2026-93479), [request body injection](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) vulnerability in HTTP/3 (CVE-2026-95101), [session forgery](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) vulnerability when using TLS session ticket key rotation (CVE-2026-97629), and [use-after-free](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) vulnerability when using ngx_http_ssi_module with AIO (CVE-2026-97205).

See official [CHANGES](https://nginx.org/en/CHANGES) on nginx.org.

Below is a release summary generated by GitHub.

## What's Changed
* Dav: destination validation for COPY and MOVE with "alias" by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1764
* Version bump by @pluknet in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1773
* SSL: set c->error on connection reset SSL_read() error. by @pluknet in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1271
* SSL: support for iPAddress subjectAltName in certificates. by @jimf5 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1264
* Rejected zero size in buffer-size directives. by @sbhowmikf5 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1644
* HTTP/2: implement RFC 9218 Extensible Prioritization Scheme for HTTP by @ac000 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1520
* QUIC: support BPF reload and binary upgrade by @saikrishnakumarreddy in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1756
* QUIC: fixed binary upgrade from older versions by @route443 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1813
* Updated OpenSSL and PCRE used for win32 builds by @pluknet in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1816
* GeoIP2: support for GeoIP2 http & stream modules by @nitin9977 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1655


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nginx/nginx/compare/release-1.31.6...release-1.31.7

[nginx-1.31.5](https://nginx.org/en/download.html) mainline version has been [released](https://blog.nginx.org/blog/nginx-1-31-5-control-api-predicate-locations-early-body-inspection-and-more), featuring [control API](https://blog.nginx.org/blog/nginx-control-api-view-in-memory-configuration-and-reload-via-http-requests), [predicate locations](https://blog.nginx.org/blog/predicate-routing-for-native-handling-of-api-traffic), [client_body_early_read directive](https://blog.nginx.org/blog/nginx-routing-on-http-request-body) and the ngx_http_json_module.

See official [CHANGES](https://nginx.org/en/CHANGES) on nginx.org.

Below is a release summary generated by GitHub.

## What's Changed
* FastCGI, uWSGI: support for multibyte parameter name lengths by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1648
* Added client_body_early_read directive by @arut in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1641
* Added the json parser module. by @roman-f5 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1642
* Core: make channel file descriptor receive errors non-fatal by @arut in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1662
* Memcached: respect the end marker in the maximum supported length by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1637
* QUIC: rejected CRYPTO frames received in 1-RTT packets by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1638
* Slice filter: overflow protection in slice range requests by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1639
* Event pipe: do not free buffers still used by the downstream by @route443 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1664
* Predicate locations by @arut in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1633
* JSON: fixed overflow detection in length calculation by @dplotnikov-f5 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1658
* NGINX Control API by @avahahn in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1626
* Updated OpenSSL and PCRE used for win32 builds by @arut in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1715
* nginx-1.31.5-RELEASE by @arut in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1714

## New Contributors
* @route443 made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1664
* @avahahn made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1626

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nginx/nginx/compare/release-1.31.4...release-1.31.5

See official [CHANGES](https://nginx.org/en/CHANGES) on nginx.org.

Below is a release summary generated by GitHub.

## What's Changed
* Xslt: xmlCreatePushParserCtxt() error handling by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1565
* Image filter: bounded size parser reads by received data by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1574
* Updated security policy report methods by @pluknet in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1586
* Autoindex: use temporary pool for directory entries by @Srujan-rai in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1311
* Perl: fixed $r->print() zero copy with mutable scalars by @devnexen in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1581
* Events: validate descriptor before FD_SET() by @sbhowmikf5 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1598
* Format specifier fixes in error logging by @nishat-06 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1592
* GH: restrict the mark_stale job to nginx/nginx by @aminvakil in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1605
* QUIC: apply stream flow control to RESET_STREAM final_size by @arut in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1612
* Script: improved compatibility of complex value codes by @bavshin-f5 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1601
* gRPC: narrowed special handling of "trailer only" responses by @vinaykumar-1591 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1591
* Fixed overflow detection in chunked parser by @pluknet in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1625
* Upstream: special handling of the "Host" header in HTTP and gRPC by @arut in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1593
* Upstream: reject zero `WINDOW_UPDATE` increments by @felix314159 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1622
* Core: added data model and JSON serialization libraries by @hyuan-netizen in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1569
* Upstream: fixed MSVC compilation after dea68dbf126f by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1635
* Upstream: reserved padding in state structures. by @dplotnikov-f5 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1631
* Stream: PROXY protocol version 2 upstream write support by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1204

## New Contributors
* @Srujan-rai made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1311
* @nishat-06 made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1592
* @aminvakil made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1605
* @felix314159 made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1622

* nginx-1.31.3-RELEASE by @pluknet in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1562

* Xslt: fixed handle vsnprintf return value by @afonot in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/747
* GH: remove the set-creation-date.yaml workflow by @ac000 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1435

* Access log: Fix "request_length" format length by @nitin9977 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1432
* Updated OpenSSL used for win32 builds by @pluknet in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1469
* Nginx 1.31.2 with security fixes (HTTP/2 proxy, grpc, HTTP/3, charset) by @arut in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1474

* @afonot made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/747
* @sbhowmikf5 made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1433
* @nitin9977 made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1432
